1: // Game based on IDEA.md – Space Drift
2: (function(){
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if(!canvas){ console.error('Canvas #game not found'); return; }
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // full‑window canvas
7:   function resize(){
8:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
9:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
10:   }
11:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
12:   resize();
13: 
14:   // Input handling
15:   const keys = {};
16:   window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>keys[e.key]=true);
17:   window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.key]=false);
18: 
19:   // Ship definition
20:   const ship = {
21:     x: canvas.width/2,
22:     y: canvas.height/2,
23:     angle: 0,
24:     radius: 10,
25:     speed: 0,
26:     maxSpeed: 4,
27:     thrust: 0.1,
28:     drag: 0.02
29:   };
30: 
31:   // Stars background
32:   const stars = [];
33:   for(let i=0;i<100;i++) stars.push({x:Math.random()*canvas.width,y:Math.random()*canvas.height,size:Math.random()*2+1});
34: 
35:   // Asteroids
36:   const asteroids = [];
37:   function spawnAsteroid(){
38:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random()*4);
39:     let x,y,vx,vy;
40:     const radius = Math.random()*15+10;
41:     const speed = Math.random()*1.5+0.5;
42:     if(edge===0){ x=0; y=Math.random()*canvas.height; vx=speed; vy=(Math.random()-0.5)*speed; }
43:     else if(edge===1){ x=canvas.width; y=Math.random()*canvas.height; vx=-speed; vy=(Math.random()-0.5)*speed; }
44:     else if(edge===2){ x=Math.random()*canvas.width; y=0; vx=(Math.random()-0.5)*speed; vy=speed; }
45:     else { x=Math.random()*canvas.width; y=canvas.height; vx=(Math.random()-0.5)*speed; vy=-speed; }
46:     asteroids.push({x,y,vx,vy,radius});
47:   }
48:   // initial asteroids
49:   for(let i=0;i=0;i<5;i++) spawnAsteroid();
50: 
51:   let score=0;
52:   let fuel=100; // percent
53:   let lastTime=0;
54:   const fuelDrainRate=0.02; // per ms
55: 
56:   function update(dt){
57:     // input
58:     if(keys['ArrowUp']||keys['w']) ship.speed = Math.min(ship.maxSpeed, ship.speed + ship.thrust);
59:     if(keys['ArrowDown']||keys['s']) ship.speed = Math.max(0, ship.speed - ship.thrust);
60:     if(keys['ArrowLeft']||keys['a']) ship.angle -= 0.05;
61:     if(keys['ArrowRight']||keys['d']) ship.angle += 0.05;
62: 
63:     // apply drag
64:     ship.speed *= 1-ship.drag;
65:     // move ship
66:     ship.x += Math.cos(ship.angle)*ship.speed;
67:     ship.y += Math.sin(ship.angle)*ship.speed;
68:     // wrap around edges
69:     if(ship.x<0) ship.x+=canvas.width; if(ship.x>canvas.width) ship.x-=canvas.width;
70:     if(ship.y<0) ship.y+=canvas.height; if(ship.y>canvas.height) ship.y-=canvas.height;
71: 
72:     // update asteroids
73:     for(let i=asteroids.length-1;i>=0;i--){
74:       const a=asteroids[i];
75:       a.x+=a.vx; a.y+=a.vy;
76:       // wrap
77:       if(a.x<0) a.x+=canvas.width; if(a.x>canvas.width) a.x-=canvas.width;
78:       if(a.y<0) a.y+=canvas.height; if(a.y>canvas.height) a.y-=canvas.height;
79:       // collision with ship
80:       const dx=a.x-ship.x, dy=a.y-ship.y;
81:       const dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
82:       if(dist<a.radius+ship.radius){
83:         // game over
84:         alert('Game Over! Score: '+Math.floor(score));
85:         document.location.reload();
86:         return;
87:       }
88:     }
89:     // spawn new asteroids over time
90:     if(Math.random()<dt*0.001) spawnAsteroid();
91: 
92:     // fuel consumption
93:     fuel -= dt*fuelDrainRate;
94:     if(fuel<=0){ alert('Out of fuel! Score: '+Math.floor(score)); document.location.reload(); return; }
95: 
96:     score += dt*0.01; // increase score over time
97:   }
98: 
99:   function draw(){
100:     ctx.fillStyle='black';
101:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
102:     // stars
103:     ctx.fillStyle='white';
104:     stars.forEach(s=>{ ctx.fillRect(s.x,s.y,s.size,s.size); });
105:     // ship
106:     ctx.save();
107:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
108:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
109:     ctx.fillStyle='cyan';
110:     ctx.beginPath();
111:     ctx.moveTo(15,0);
112:     ctx.lineTo(-10,10);
113:     ctx.lineTo(-10,-10);
114:     ctx.closePath();
115:     ctx.fill();
116:     ctx.restore();
117:     // asteroids
118:     ctx.fillStyle='gray';
119:     asteroids.forEach(a=>{ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(a.x,a.y,a.radius,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); });
120:     // HUD
121:     ctx.fillStyle='white';
122:     ctx.font='16px sans-serif';
123:     ctx.fillText('Score: '+Math.floor(score),10,20);
124:     ctx.fillText('Fuel: '+Math.floor(fuel)+'%',10,40);
125:   }
126: 
127:   function loop(timestamp){
128:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
129:     lastTime = timestamp;
130:     update(dt);
131:     draw();
132:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
133:   }
134:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
135: })();

(End of file - total 135 lines)
</content>
